LibVLC (`libvlc\win-x64\` next to CONVERTit.exe: libvlc.dll, libvlccore.dll and the plugins folder) and the
LibVLCSharp assemblies are shipped unmodified as separate dynamic libraries. You may replace them with your own
compatible build (LGPL section 6). The complete corresponding source code is available from the VideoLAN
repositories linked above for the version shipped (see the file properties of libvlc.dll).
